latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Batch Video Creator Online — create and export multiple videos at once, hands-free.

- Upload multiple video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB each) and generate individual branded videos with intros, outros, and captions.
- Automated cloud-based rendering with easy setup: get a free token, process jobs without manual editing per clip.
- Download finished 1080p MP4 videos, ready to post, in about 1–3 minutes per batch.
- Supports batch processing, quick edits, and iterative refinement; all API logic and error handling included.
- Designed for marketers needing fast, consistent video content creation.
